Starts the Pro (business staff) password reset. Sends a six-digit one-time code to the account email; the code expires after 10 minutes and is accepted once. Returns `00` even when the email is unknown, so the endpoint cannot be used to discover accounts. Finish with `POST /business/resetpassword/` using `otp` + `newpassword`.
